name: Wild Kratts
description: The adventures of Chris and Martin Kratt as they encounter incredible wild animals, combining science education with fun and adventure as the duo travels to animal habitats around the globe.

videos.title: Mom of a Croc
videos.overview: Chris and Martin are determined to prove to Aviva that there's more to crocodiles than their reputation as scary brutes.

videos.title: Whale of a Squid
videos.overview: The Kratt brothers are taking Aviva’s submarine prototype out for a test drive when the vehicle gets sucked into a battle between a Sperm whale and Giant squid, spiraling down into the depths.

videos.title: Aardvark Town
videos.overview: After a young aardvark accidentally becomes a stowaway in Chris's backpack, the Wild Kratts team sets off on a “door to door” search to return him to his home burrow.

videos.title: Flight of the Draco
videos.overview: While on a mission to discover the secret of the Draco lizard’s gliding abilities, Martin and Chris uncover an evil plot devised by villainous fashion designer, Donita Donata.

videos.title: Mystery of the Squirmy Wormy
videos.overview: Aviva miniaturizes Chris and Martin for a fascinating underground mission to meet earthworms and “dig up” the answer to the mystery of why worms come above ground when it rains.

videos.title: Platypus Café
videos.overview: On a kayaking expedition in Australia, the brothers encounter one of the world’s most unusual creatures: a platypus mother with her eggs.

videos.title: Polar Bears Don't Dance
videos.overview: Martin and Chris are on a mission in the Arctic to discover just how animals move around in different environments.

videos.title: Build It Beaver
videos.overview: When the Wild Kratts creature adventurers accidentally break a beaver dam, they must lend a hand to help the beaver family rebuild it and restore the pond ecosystem for all the creatures who live there.

videos.title: Voyage of the Butterflier XT
videos.overview: Using Aviva’s newest invention, the Butterflier XT, the miniaturized Kratt Brothers embark on the most incredible insect voyage in the world.

videos.title: Honey Seekers
videos.overview: While on an adventure to discover the toughest animal in Africa, Chris and Martin uncover the amazing symbiotic relationships between bees, the Honey guide bird and the Honey badger.

videos.title: Bass Class
videos.overview: Martin and Chris are in the middle of a friendly competition to find Smallmouth and Largemouth bass when they encounter Gavin, a “Wild Kratts Kid” who is fishing.

videos.title: Fireflies
videos.overview: It’s time for the annual Wild Kratts Firefly Picnic so the brothers head off into the forest to find some fireflies to join the fun.

videos.title: Mystery of the Weird Looking Walrus
videos.overview: Chris and Martin are out to investigate why the walrus looks so weird, but then find out that Zach Varmitech has kidnapped an entire herd to mine precious pearls for Donita Donata’s fashion line.

videos.title: Tazzy Chris
videos.overview: Martin and Chris discover that Zach Varmitech has begun kidnapping them to create a ferocious new Zachbot.

videos.title: Octopus Wildkratticus
videos.overview: When Martin accidentally knocks the Creature Power Suits into a deep Arctic trench, Aviva takes the brothers to search for them in her brand-new Octopod submarine.

videos.title: Walk On the Wetside
videos.overview: When Chris and Martin locate an amazing water-walking Basilisk lizard in Costa Rica, they try to replicate its actions in order to learn how this rare lizard is able to walk on water.

videos.title: Elephant in the Room
videos.overview: The brothers come across a lone baby elephant and bring him back to the Tortuga HQ for safety until they can find his mom.

videos.title: Let the Rhinos Roll!
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts team is on an important mission to unearth why Rhinos are mysteriously disappearing from the African Savannah.

videos.title: Falcon City
videos.overview: The Kratt brothers are itching to fly with the world’s fastest animal, the Peregrine falcon, which can hit top speeds of 240 mph.

videos.title: The Blue and the Gray
videos.overview: Martin and Chris are absorbed in a hilarious competition to discover who is the best acorn planter, blue jays or gray squirrels.

videos.title: Kickin' It With the Roos
videos.overview: When Chris and Martin meet up with a mob of Red kangaroos, they get their car keys stolen by a joey and have to figure out how to get them back from the tricky little guy.

videos.title: Koala Balloon
videos.overview: Martin and Chris must protect a young koala stranded in the Australian Outback, and help him get back to his Eucalyptus forest habitat.

videos.title: Cheetah Racer
videos.overview: Chris and Martin announce that no creature or vehicle can travel as fast over the rough and tumble African savannah as the cheetah.

videos.title: Stuck On Sharks
videos.overview: Martin and Chris are on a mission to uncover the secret life of the mysterious Great White Shark.

videos.title: Mimic
videos.overview: While exploring why some animals mimic the looks of others, Martin and Chris encounter a cheetah cub and its mom.

videos.title: Little Howler
videos.overview: Chris and Martin are unpacking from an adventure and are surprised when a Wolf pup pops out of their bags.

videos.title: Raptor Round-Up
videos.overview: Martin and Chris challenge themselves to ID as many hawks, eagles, owls, falcons and vultures as they can.

videos.title: A Bat in the Brownies
videos.overview: When a little brown bat crashlands into a plate of Jimmy Z’s famous brownies, Martin and Chris out set out to convince Aviva, Jimmy Z and Koki that bats are nothing to be afraid of.

videos.title: Masked Bandits
videos.overview: As they prepare for a creature costume party, the Wild Kratts team begins to notice all sorts of strange things happening in the Tortuga HQ.

videos.title: Ker-honk
videos.overview: The Kratt brothers find themselves stepping into the injured monkey’s role.

videos.title: The Food Chain Game
videos.overview: Aviva wants to build a food web for the African savannah, so she devises a game and Martin and Chris accept her challenge!

videos.title: Flight of the Pollinators
videos.overview: When a miniaturized Chris gets covered with pollen and ends up sticking to a bee, he’s off into the remarkable world of the pollinators.

videos.title: Caracal-Minton
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts crew is playing badminton on the African savannah when a high jumping wildcat called a caracal steals the birdie.

videos.title: Zig-Zagged
videos.overview: Chris and Martin get caught in the middle of a Zebra stampede, and when the dust clears, a lone baby Zebra is left behind.

videos.title: A Huge Orange Problem
videos.overview: Koki and Jimmy get carried away swinging on vines and their muscles so get incredibly sore that they can’t do anything.

videos.title: Birds of a Feather
videos.overview: Chris and Martin set out in the New Guinea forest to inspire Aviva to give dancing a try by uncovering some of the greatest dancers in the creature world – the Birds of Paradise.

videos.title: Seasquatch
videos.overview: The Kratt brothers’ sub loses power while they are exploring the strange landscape of the ocean depths and they are trapped on the ocean floor of the deep sea.

videos.title: The Gecko Effect
videos.overview: There’s a mystery to be solved, as the Wild Kratts team wonders how a Gecko lizard climbs up smooth surfaces and can even climb upside down.

videos.title: Googly-Eye: The Night Guru
videos.overview: The Kratt brothers secretly “borrow” Aviva’s half finished night vision goggles to go in search of a mysterious nocturnal creature.

videos.title: Quillber's Birthday Present
videos.overview: It’s Aviva’s birthday, and Chris and Martin decide to collect shed porcupine quills to make a beautiful necklace as a gift.

videos.title: Bad Hair Day
videos.overview: Martin and Chris try to help a male lion get past obstacles and get back to its pride, which is under siege from two intruder lions.

videos.title: Race for the Hippo Disc
videos.overview: Chris and Martin try to find a power disc that they lost on the African Savannah before it falls into the hands of Zach Varmitech.

videos.title: Creature Power Challenge
videos.overview: Martin and Chris hold a contest to see which animals are strongest, fastest, and best swimmers in Africa.

videos.title: Termites Versus Tongues
videos.overview: Aviva and Koki accidentally miniaturize themselves and get carried away by termites.

videos.title: Secrets of the Spider's Web
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts team attempts to uncover the secret to spider silk while keeping Donita from including the valuable substance in her latest fashion line.

videos.title: Happy Turkey Day
videos.overview: Martin and Chris must defend the honor of the wild turkey and prove that it has some amazing creature powers too.

videos.title: Neck and Neck
videos.overview: While trying to uncover the mystery of the giraffe’s long neck, the Tortuga crew encounter a mischievous giraffe that starts stealing their supplies.

videos.title: Speaking Dolphinese
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts team is on a mission to decode the secret language of the dolphin with one of Aviva’s new inventions, but a hungry great white shark puts their new animal friends in harm’s way.

videos.title: Blowfish Blowout
videos.overview: The Kratt brothers discover a beautiful coral reef and a couple of blowfish, which they then must protect from Donita.

videos.title: To Touch a Hummingbird
videos.overview: Amazed by the hummingbird’s unique flight capabilities, Martin and Chris try to track one down but soon learn that Gourmand has just added hummingbird eggs to his menu.

videos.title: Rainforest Stew
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts must stop Gourmand from creating a “rainforest stew” and disturbing the delicate balance of the rainforest ecosystem.

videos.title: Seahorse Rodeo
videos.overview: The Kratt brothers discover a herd of seahorses living near a coral reef, but their investigation is interrupted when Donita eyes the little creatures as part of her next fashion trend.

videos.title: Aquafrog
videos.overview: Martin and Chris are studying bullfrogs when Zach decides to dump his waste in the same pond, threatening the frog’s delicate lifecycle.

videos.title: Snow Runners
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts accidentally lose three hispid hares in wintery North America, and must use the powers of the “snow runners” to get them back.

videos.title: Tortuga Tune-Up
videos.overview: Aviva wants to upgrade the Tortuga with swimming capabilities, and so the Kratt brothers seek out a sea turtle for inspiration.

videos.title: Road Runner
videos.overview: While trying to catch an elusive lizard in the Sonoran Desert, Martin and Chris stumble upon a roadrunner and try to use its running powers to uncover the identity of the mystery lizard.

videos.title: Rocket Jaw: Rescuer of the Reef
videos.overview: The bros discover a frogfish while exploring a coral reef, only to also find that Zach and Donita are stealing parts of the reef as part of their next scheme.

videos.title: Attack of the Alien Tree Eaters
videos.overview: The Tortuga crew gets a distress call from some Wild Kratts kids and must investigate why the forest around the kids’ clubhouse is dying.

videos.title: Rattlesnake Crystal
videos.overview: The Kratt bros must use rattlesnake powers to find rare tellurium crystal, or else the Tortuga will go offline forever!

videos.title: Skunked!
videos.overview: The Tortuga is taken over by skunks, and the Wild Kratts crew must uncover the secret behind their stink to get it back.

videos.title: Gila Monster Under My House
videos.overview: Chris and Martin set out to prove that gila monsters are misunderstood lizards, and also to protect them from becoming part of Zach’s latest invention.

videos.title: Bugs or Monkeys?
videos.overview: While arguing over their next adventure, Chris and Martin meet a group of spider monkeys! But when a miniaturized Martin is carried away by a baby monkey, the rest of the Tortuga crew must work to find him.

videos.title: Shadow: the Black Jaguar
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts respond to a distress call in South America to find that Zach Varmitech is trying to kidnap a rare black jaguar for use in his latest invention scheme.

videos.title: Desert Elves
videos.overview: When Koki and Jimmy get stranded in the Sonoran Desert, the Kratt bros must use the powers of the “desert elves” to track them down before it’s too late.

videos.title: Journey to the Subnivean Zone
videos.overview: A miniaturized Chris and Martin get lost in a snowy field and uncover the secret underground world of the meadow vole.

videos.title: Groundhog Wake Up Call
videos.overview: Aviva tries to prove that groundhogs have amazing creature powers, but instead falls into a deep sleep, leaving the Kratt bros to discover all about hibernation.

videos.title: Hermit Crab Shell Exchange
videos.overview: Martin and Chris discover a hermit crab on the beach, and soon the Wild Kratts team is exploring the amazing world of this shell changing creature!

videos.title: Where the Bison Roam
videos.overview: When the team explores the spot where explorers Lewis and Clark first laid eyes on the American frontier, they discover that prairies and the amazing bison herds of yore are much harder to find these days.

videos.title: Bandito: The Black-Footed Ferret
videos.overview: Aviva’s new stone digger invention flies out of control and Martin is stranded in a hidden prairie where he encounters a lost colony of black footed ferrets.

videos.title: When Fish Fly!
videos.overview: Martin and Chris challenge Koki and Aviva to a contest regarding who has the most challenging job.

videos.title: Osprey
videos.overview: Jimmy accidentally drops the keys to the Tortuga into the ocean, sending Chris, Martin, and Aviva on a race to develop osprey creature powers to find the keys before they disappear forever!

videos.title: Back in Creature Time, Part 1 – Day of the Dodo
videos.overview: After lamenting the extinction of different animals in recent history and how they’ll never get to adventure with them, Aviva unveils her greatest invention yet – a time trampoline! The Wild Kratts jump back to the time of the extinct dodo bird, but once there, they run into Gourmand’s ancestor, who has decided dodos are definitely on the menu! Once again, it’s Wild Kratts to the rescue!

videos.title: Back in Creature Time, Part 2 – Tasmanian Tiger
videos.overview: After visiting the dodos, the Wild Kratts travel to another time period to visit another extinct animal – the Tasmanian tiger! Their trip doesn’t go as planned, however, and they must save the Tasmanian tigers from Dabio and Donita’s ancestors, while also saving themselves from Zach, who wants to trap them in the past forever!

videos.title: The Amazing Creature Race
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts crew decide to have a creature power race to find out who the greatest runners are in the animal world!

videos.title: Prairie Who?
videos.overview: A twister catches the Tortuga mid-flight, forcing the crew to abandon ship. While trying to find each other, the team discovers several amazing creatures living on the prairie.

videos.title: Mystery on the Prarie
videos.overview: When Martin and Chris find an unusual thorn bush with “spiked” grasshoppers and beetles, they set out to uncover the identity of the mystery culprit.

videos.title: Crocogator Contest
videos.overview: A pop Creature Quiz challenge about the the differences between crocodiles and alligators turns into a full-blown “crocogator” contest to find out what actually is different about these two similar creatures.

videos.title: Mosquito Dragon
videos.overview: When the Wild Kratts crew get walloped by mosquitoes in the Cypress Swamp, the gang go on a fact finding adventure to find out exactly why mosquitoes try and steal our blood in the first place!

videos.title: Slider: The Otter
videos.overview: The bros attempt to find the family of a lost otter cub, while introducing him to life in the Cypress Swamp of Florida.

videos.title: Search for the Florida Panther
videos.overview: The team searches for an injured endangered Florida panther spotted off Alligator Alley highway.

videos.title: Opossum in My Pocket
videos.overview: The brothers come across a marsupial opossum while searching for Chris' lost goggles in the swamp.

videos.title: Praying Mantis
videos.overview: Two Wild Kratts kids wake up to find a praying mantis cocoon has hatched in their room – with over 200 babies! The Tortuga crew swoops in to help return the baby mantises safely back to the wild.

videos.title: Under Frozen Pond
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts crew and kids go on an underwater adventure to discover how pond animals survive in the winter.

videos.title: Chameleon on Target
videos.overview: Aviva’s special ring chip invention is stolen by a mysterious lemur! Chris and Martin set off after it, with a little help from the amazing creature powers of the chameleon.

videos.title: Lemur Stink Fight
videos.overview: While in Madagascar, the Wild Kratts hear signs of a dispute between two troops of ring-tailed lemurs.

videos.title: Capture the Fishmobile
videos.overview: When Aviva unveils her new Fishmobile invention, Chris and Martin challenge the gang to a brand new creature game.

videos.title: Aye Aye
videos.overview: When the Wild Kratts team embarks on a pirate adventure in the Indian Ocean, they discover a very strange, other-worldly castaway.

videos.title: Tenrec Treasure Hunt
videos.overview: When Chris sets up an elaborate treasure hunt centering on a cool and rare group of insectivores – the tenrec – the rest of the crew sets off to complete the hunt.

videos.title: Lemur Legs
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts arrive in Madagascar for the first time, touching down in the southern region known as the Spiny Desert, where they discover a group of sifaka lemurs.

videos.title: Golden Bamboo Lemur
videos.overview: While in Madagascar, the Wild Kratts learn that a baby golden bamboo lemur has been born.

videos.title: Fossa Palooza!
videos.overview: Chris accidentally falls mid-flight out of the Tortuga and lands back in Madagascar, surrounded by the amazing fossa!

videos.title: Mini Madagascar
videos.overview: With no big land predators, Chris realizes that Madagascar is one of the safest places in the world for miniaturized adventuring, but the “mini” Kratts soon discover they may have underestimated this unique island!

videos.title: The Last Largest Lobster
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts are having a picnic when a seagull steals one of their creature power discs and drops it into the ocean. The Kratt Bros dive in to retrieve the disc and encounter an enormous lobster. Martin and Chris begin to follow him to investigate the life of a lobster. But there's someone else on the lobster's trail. It's Chef Gourmand Gaston, who plans to catch him and "cook him up".

videos.title: Stars of the Tides
videos.overview: When Martin and Chris argue about who gets to keep a prized creature souvenir, Aviva unveils a new Creature Power Challenge that should settle things. This time, Martin and Chris must make it through the day in one of the harshest habitats on Earth, the rocky intertidal. The Kratt Bros. must use the creature powers of the intertidal to outlast each other and win the prize.

videos.title: Box Turtled In!
videos.overview: When the Wild Kratts Tortuga is accidentally miniaturized and carried off by a coyote, the mothership's shell defense is finally put to the test. The gang embarks on a box turtle-style mission to get back to the Miniaturizer and restore the Tortuga back to normal size

videos.title: The Other Martins
videos.overview: It's a relaxing day at Tortuga HQ when Chris comes in complaining about Martin. Confused, the gang soon discovers that Chris means a bird called the Purple martin and not his brother! Chris is not happy about something else named Martin and when a second creature called Martin comes along, but soon, comes to understand what awesome creatures these "Other Martins" really are.

videos.title: Sea Otter Swim
videos.overview: Jimmy finally admits to the crew that he's not a strong swimmer. Determined to help him, Martin and Chris take Jimmy to get swimming lessons from a Sea Otter named Couch.

videos.title: Animals Who Live to Be 100 Years Old
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts travel around the world to find and protect the oldest living animals in the world from Zach Varmitech who wants to use their secrets of long life to live forever.

videos.title: Spirit Bear
videos.overview: Martin and Chris take Aviva to Bear Island to search for black bears and learn more about their creature powers. But they find more than what they expect and they meet their newest villain, Paisley Paver.

videos.title: Panda Power Up!
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts travel to China to conduct a population survey of one of Aviva's favorite animals: the giant panda. However, Zach Varmitech has plans to capture the pandas and make them into robotic toys. When Zach discovers that the Wild Kratts have arrived in China, he has his Zachbots drain the power from the team's technology, leaving the Wild Kratts stranded in the bamboo forest. To make matters worse, Zach captures Martin, who is testing the new Giant Panda Creature Power Suit, along with the real pandas. The Wild Kratts will need to use the bamboo-digesting secrets of the giant panda to convert bamboo into energy, "panda power up" their technology, and rescue Martin and the pandas from Zach.

videos.title: Pangolin Rescue
videos.overview: After discovering a pangolin and its amazingly unique keratin scales, the Wild Kratts receive an alert from two Wild Kratt kids in China. The pangolins in their forest are in trouble! The gang responds, uncovering Chef Gourmand Gaston's latest plan to make Smoothies using pangolin scales. The Wild Kratts must tap into the real power of the pangolin's scales - as an incredible defense - to rescue this little-known creature.

videos.title: Golden Snub Nosed Monkey Man
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts go on an expedition into the Chinese mountains to find the amazing Snub nosed monkeys, a species of cold-adapted monkeys living in the snowy highlands. But when Martin becomes separated in an avalanche and his power suit malfunctions, it's a race against time for the Wild Kratts to find Martin, the Giant Snub-nosed Monkey Man!

videos.title: Red Panda Rescue
videos.overview: Chris finds a lost Red Panda in the Bamboo forests of China. He decides to show the crew his new little friend. But little do they know is that Zach Varmitech is after the little panda, and plans on making it Donita's birthday present.

videos.title: The Colors of China
videos.overview: While in China, the Kratt brothers encounter golden pheasants. From seeing how colorful they are, they then begin to wonder about the importance of color to certain animals in China. However, Donita Donata plans to capture several animals of china and bleaches their coats in order to use them as statues for a drab fashion show.

videos.title: Creatures of the Deep Sea: Part 1
videos.overview: With Aviva's new submarine the Wild Kratts head down deeper than they have ever been before into the sea to discover bizarre creatures and maybe even a new species. But Chef Gourmand is also looking for rare sea creatures down there.

videos.title: Creatures of the Deep Sea: Part 2
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts attempt to stop Gourmand from cooking deep sea creatures and learn more about the deep sea in the process.

videos.title: Liturgusa Krattorum
videos.overview: The Kratt brothers find out that a scientist has discovered a new species of mantis in Peru and named it Liturgusa krattorum, after them. They decide to creature adventure with this unique insect. Meanwhile, villains Zach Varmitech, Donita Donata, and Chef Gourmand are upset that the mantis was named after the Kratt brothers instead of after them, so they decide to capture all of the Liturgusa krattorum. The Wild Kratts must rescue the mantises and get them back to "living free and in the wild"

videos.title: Snowy Owl Invasion
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts hear about snowy owls being sighted in areas far south of their usual Arctic habitat. The team decides to investigate, but trouble starts when Donita Donata decides to make hats out of the snowy owls.

videos.title: Puffin Rescue
videos.overview: A rouge wave crashes into the Tortuga, separating the crew. Each crew member is on there own, except for Martin. On his island, he discovers a creature who might be able to help. A Puffin.

videos.title: Eel-lectric!
videos.overview: When the Tortuga crashes in the Amazon rainforest, the ship's electrical systems get damaged. However, Chris and Martin soon find a creature that may be able to solve the Tortuga's electricity problem: the electric eel.

videos.title: Mystery of the Two Horned Narwhal
videos.overview: While the Kratt Brothers are observing the differences between horns and antlers, Wild Kratts Kid Ronan tells them they should do an adventure with Narwhals. And soon the Wild Kratts enter the world of Tusks.

videos.title: Archerfish School
videos.overview: Chris has decided to practice something he always wanted to do, Archery. Only he's not very good at it. So he decides to take lessons from one of the greatest archers in nature, the Archerfish. But can he learn this skill in time to stop Donita Donata's newest fashion line.

videos.title: This Orca Likes Sharks
videos.overview: The Kratt brothers find a map showing the travels of a legendary orca that supposedly specializes in eating large sharks, causing them to search for it.

videos.title: Baby Tooth and Kid Musky
videos.overview: The Kratt Brothers are in the Arctic checking out two different animals, the MuskOx and the Arctic Wolf. Martin wants Aviva to make MuskOx powers and Chris wants her to make Arctic Wolf powers. But they soon realize that the relationship between these two creatures is not a friendly competition.

videos.title: Cheetah Adopted
videos.overview: The Kratt Brothers are in the African Savanna exploring, while waiting for the rest of the crew to get back from there supply run. While exploring, Martin and Chris see there Cheetah cub friend Spot Swat. But he has been adopted, by a Warthog.

videos.title: Musk Ox Mania
videos.overview: Chris forgets his valuable souvenir collection in the Arctic tundra, so the Wild Kratts travel there to search for the collection using the Creature Powers of the musk ox before Zach Varmitech gets his hands on it.

videos.title: A Creature Christmas
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts are celebrating their annual Christmas party, when they receive alerts that Zach Varmitech, Donita Donata, and Gourmand are capturing infant animals from all over the world. They postpone their party in order to stop them. After failing to stop the villains the first time, the Wild Kratts continue to postpone their Christmas party in order to stop the villains' plan to use infant animals as decorations in a shopping mall.

videos.title: Mystery of the North Pole Penguin
videos.overview: Wild Kratts learn about the secret creature powers of Penguins in Antarctica, as well as why most penguins only live there. They however get word from Wild Kratt Kid Nua that there are penguins in the Arctic.

videos.title: Temple Of Tigers
videos.overview: Worried that they have lost there "creature senses", Chris and Martin head to India to find the master of stealth, the Tiger. But little do they know they are being followed by Donita.

videos.title: The Dhole Duplicator
videos.overview: Believing their is a dog called a Dhole that is tough enough to stand up to a Tiger, Martin and Chris search for this elusive creature. Meanwhile Aviva finishes her latest invention.

videos.title: The Cobra King
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts search for Martin's Creature Pod only to discover that a Spectacled Cobra is sitting on it.

videos.title: Fire Salamander
videos.overview: Martin and Chris are in Germany's Black Forest when they find a Salamander crawling out of there campfire. They try to figure out how these Fire Salamanders are able to do this. Donita Donata, however, over hears this and decides to make a fire proof body suit out of the Salamanders skins.

videos.title: Cheeks The Hamster
videos.overview: Aviva loses her Micro XT Power chips in the forest of Germany. Knowing they are a important peace of technology the Wild Kratts turn to the help of the Creature Powers of the Hamster.

videos.title: Wild Ponies
videos.overview: After a storm, the Wild Kratts must return a lost horse foal to its mother.

videos.title: Elephant Brains
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts go to India to find the difference between African and Asian Elephants. But find out how complex these creatures really are. Meanwhile Paisley Paver plans on using the elephants as beasts of burden.

videos.title: Sloth Bear Suction
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts recieve a call from Wild Kratts kid Mala about an endangered creature called a Sloth Bear. They do more research on the animal while also trying to save it from Donita's fashion line.

videos.title: City Hoppers!
videos.overview: While Aviva and Koki help Wild Kratts kids Nolan and Sani build a Catapult, Martin and Chris try to explore the creature powers of the Grasshopper. Meanwhile, Donita Donata and Paisley Paver meet at Zach Varmitech's headquarters

videos.title: Blue Heron
videos.overview: While traveling on a dirt road, the Wild Kratts discover a Blue Heron and take the time to observe its physical features and hunting strategies. Zach Varmitech takes this opportunity to make an attack on the Tortuga.

videos.title: Choose Your Swordfish
videos.overview: Aviva challenges the Kratt Brothers to a fencing competition. But they will only accept the challenge if she makes a creature power suit for one of the three kinds of billfish- Swordfish, Marlin, and Sailfish. Meanwhile, Zach starts collecting fish from the ocean.

videos.title: Komodo Dragon
videos.overview: While doing her usual 'villain checkup', Koki notices Chef Gourmand traveling to the island of Komodo. Believing she has heard the name before she asks the Kratt brother about the island. Martin and Chris then realize that there's only one animal on that island that would satisfy Gourmands taste, the Komodo Dragon.

videos.title: The Fourth Bald Eagle
videos.overview: Martin and Chris help out when a bald eagle goes missing.  Villain of the Week: Chef Gourmand  Animal names: Stars, Stripes, Downy, Little Sis

videos.title: The Erminator
videos.overview: While Martin and Chris explore the powers of the chickadee, Martin encounters an Ermine and follows it to the Ermine's prey.

videos.title: Hercules – The Giant Beetle
videos.overview: While investigating exoskeletons, the Hercules beetle accidentally gets enlarged.

videos.title: Hero's Journey
videos.overview: When Aviva's new Time Thruster invention gets attached to a migrating salmon, the Wild Kratts must follow the salmon run through the Alaskan wilderness to recover the Time Thruster.

videos.title: Creepy Creatures
videos.overview: The villains are stealing animals for a haunted house and the Wild Kratts and Wild Kratts kids must stop them and save their animal friends.

videos.title: Mystery of the Flamingo's Pink
videos.overview:
When Aviva makes a flamingo power suit that turns white, the team sets out to discover how flamingos become pink.

Villain of the week: Chef Gourmand

videos.title: Spots in the Desert
videos.overview:
The Wild Kratts receive a call from Manuel that an ocelot has been spotted in the desert.

Villain of the week: None

videos.title: Deer Buckaroo
videos.overview:
The Wild Kratts search for a white-tailed deer named Buckaroo as they learn about deer society and their antlers.

Villain of the week: None

videos.title: Wolf Hawks
videos.overview:
While hiking in the Sonoran Desert, Martin comes across a "wolf hawk". He rushes back to the Tortuga to tell everybody the news, only to have Chris say there is no such thing. What he saw was a Harris's hawk. Martin is determined to prove why these raptors should be renamed and he takes the Wild Kratts team on a mission to learn about these amazing birds.

Villain of the Week: Zach Varmitech, Chef Gourmand (cameo in a flashback, but has no dialogue)

Animal Names: Wolfish, Wolfie, Hairy, mentioned: Little Howler (From "Little Howler")

videos.title: Hammerheads
videos.overview: Martin spots a hammerhead shark while diving in the ocean.

videos.title: The Real Ant Farm
videos.overview: Martin, Chris, and Aviva go on an adventure into the Amazon Rainforest, where they find a hidden world of busy leafcutter ants, farming for the colony. The team learns about agriculture in nature, and these ants must clip leaves to bring back food. Then later, Martin learns that leafcutter ants are fungus farmers. Unfortuntely, Zach wants to make robo-ants and steal all the veggies in the world so that everyone has to buy the veggies from him. The Kratts must stop him and save Scarlett's family farm.

videos.title: Mystery of the Mini Monkey Models
videos.overview:
The Wild Kratts team splits up to find mini monkeys known as tamarins & marmosets to discover why they have such weird hairstyles & bright colors.

Villain of the week: Donita Donata

Animal names: Thumb, Pointer

videos.title: The Vanishing Stingray
videos.overview:
Bored Martin & Chris decide to play a game of creature hide-&-seek, & search the sand flats for one of the greatest hiding animals in the ocean - the stingray.

Villain of the week: Zach Varmitech

Animal names: Smiley, Click, Whistle (both from "Speaking Dolphinese")

videos.title: Spring Bunnies (In Search of the Easter Bunny)
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts team is busy decorating the Tortuga and coloring Easter eggs for their Easter Party when Chris and Martin get into a debate about which bunny is the easter bunny; Chris thinks it's the Snowshoe Hare, while Martin thinks it's the Jackrabbit. So they split up; Martin goes South, while Chris goes North in search of their candidate for the Easter Bunny.

videos.title: Amazin' Amazon Adventure
videos.overview: When Aviva experiences an invention slump, the Wild Kratts team is determined to help. They take her down the mysterious Amazon River in search of inspiration from the amazing creatures that live there. But Aviva must reclaim her invention prowess fast, because Zach, Donita, Gourmand, and Paisley seek to mine the area's biodiversity for their own nefarious schemes.

videos.title: The Great Froggyback Ride
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts are creature adventuring in the Amazon when they accidentally get miniaturized again. A mischievous monkey makes off with the Miniaturizer and the team must rely on the creature powers of the poison frog, going on a wild froggyback (Chris back) ride to rescue the Miniaturizer, or stay mini-sized forever!

videos.title: Parrot Power
videos.overview: While flying over the Amazon rainforest, the gang share a bowl of colorful jelly beans. Martin tells them that the jelly beans remind him of parrots. This confuses everybody until he says it's because parrots come in almost every color. Soon the bros are off on a creature mission to find as many colorful parrots (including macaws containing their favourite colors) as they can in the Amazon. But they need to stop Donita Donata from stealing the macaw's feathers!

videos.title: Iron Wolverine
videos.overview: When Chris sets up a massive cross country race in the North, each Wild Kratts team member must set off across the tundra with little more than one form of transportation and a small pack of gear. Along the way, each team is both helped and hindered by the greatest northern cross country traveler of all - the wolverine.

videos.title: Uh-Oh Ostrich
videos.overview: While cruising across the African savanna in the Tortuga, a gust of wind blows a piece of paper out of Aviva's hand and into an ostrich nest. The bros think it's a new secret formula and they spring into action to rescue her work from one of the most protective parents on earth - the ostrich!

videos.title: The Great Creature Tail Fail
videos.overview: When a stowaway red squirrel accidentally gets loose on the African savanna, the guys activate Cheetah Powers to catch her. Unfortunately, they run into major creature power suit malfunctions. The Tail Match Modulator is broken and producing a mismatched tail with every activation. In their quest to return the red squirrel home to North America, the gang discovers the amazing variety and diverse functions of creature tails along the way.

videos.title: Adapto the Coyote
videos.overview: When a coyote pup sneaks into the Tortuga, the Wild Kratts want to learn why this creature is so adaptable.

videos.title: Tardigrade Xtreme
videos.overview: The Kratt Brothers are curious to see if there is life on other planets; meanwhile, Jimmy Z discovers a tardigrade. The Wild Kratts crew travel around the globe and discover that tardigrades can live almost anywhere, from the ocean floor to the desert.

videos.title: Cats and Dogs
videos.overview: While on the African savanna, Martin and Chris observe lots of wild cats and dogs interacting with each other. Soon, Wild Kratts kids are calling in from all over to ask about cats and dogs and whether they're like their own pets. Zach, who has been secretly listening to all the questions, comes up with scheme to capture and sell these creatures as "special" pets. The bros, Aviva, Koki, and Jimmy race to save the wild cats and dogs and protect them "living free and in the wild".

videos.title: Outfoxed
videos.overview: While in his Squirrel Creature Power Suit, Chris gets carried off by a red fox. The gang and Gourmand attempt to track them down and Mother fox must outfox everyone in order to get home to feed her super hungry (and super cute) fox kits.

videos.title: Clever the Raven
videos.overview: In the Great North Martin and Chris decide to try to find the Little Howlers wolf pack. Unexpectedly, a raven joins them on their adventure and the brothers soon learn about the incredible intelligence and ingenuity of the raven.

videos.title: Owl Odyssey
videos.overview: When the Wild Kratts get marooned and lost a world away from the Tortuga, they must embark on a long journey home. The gang finds inspiration in several owls that they encounter along the way.

videos.title: Race to Goat Mountain
videos.overview: Chris and Martin, off to explore mountain bio-zones of Goat Mountain, bump into Paisley Paver. Paisley reveals her hideous plans for a development dubbed "Asphalt Ascent." The brothers are horrified. Thinking fast, Chris challenges her to a race to the top of Goat Mountain. Whoever gets to the peak first decides the future of the mountain ecosystem.

videos.title: Our Blue and Green World
videos.overview: After disagreeing over which one is better, Martin and Chris discover the importance of blue oceans and green forests working together. And Martin and Chris need to get it together to stop Zach Varmitech's and Paisley Paver's new scheme(s).

videos.title: No Name Dream
videos.overview: Martin goes on a mission to name all the baby animals that he had previously forgotten to.

videos.title: Backpack the Camel
videos.overview: The gang goes on an expedition to discover the last remaining wild camels in the world.

videos.title: Fish out of Water
videos.overview: The Kratt brothers get stuck in the danger-filled world of a fish called the mudskipper, which can walk around on land. They need to find their creature power discs - without getting eaten. Meanwhile, Jimmy Z starts to feel a little unappreciated.

videos.title: Bumblezzzz
videos.overview: On a mini creature adventure, Martin and Chris encounter a hungry salamander and need to escape. Lost and unsure of their location, they ride a bumblebee, learning about it along the way. Unfortunately, they lose their adventure gear in the bee's pollen pockets. Meanwhile, Zach is capturing endangered bumblebees, so the brothers activate bumblebee powers too and free the bees.

videos.title: Salamander Streaming
videos.overview: Mysteriously, the Tortuga shorts and powers down while the gang is streaming a movie. Chris and Martin announce they can still do streaming—salamander streaming. The rest of the gang wonders, the brothers explain that salamander streaming is getting miniaturized and floating down a stream in tiny little boats looking for salamanders. It's a race to find as many salamanders as they can while Koki tries to fix the Tortuga.

videos.title: Chimpanzee and Me
videos.overview: The gang ventures into Uganda's tropical forests to explore the true nature of chimpanzees, but Chris sprains his ankle just as the climbing adventure begins. Upset and disappointed, he tries to hide his feelings and rely on his friends for support. Ultimately, it's a young chimp that teaches him how to embrace the situation and make the best of it.

videos.title: Activate Kid Power
videos.overview: When the Wild Kratts receive an overload of calls for creature rescues, their creature power capacity fails. The team is left helpless, but soon learn that by the working with Wild Kratts Kids that Kid Power is perhaps the most amazing and effective creature power of all!

videos.title: Mini Heroes & Mighthy Mouths
videos.overview: The brothers get swept up in the planktonic lifestyle when they go on a mission to understand the foundation of life in the ocean.

videos.title: Moose Nibbles
videos.overview: The Kratt brothers take a day off from adventuring to go camping, where they meet a mischievous little moose calf.

videos.title: Duck, Duck, Loon!
videos.overview: When Chris and Martin lose their gear to a snapping turtle, they are stuck mini-sized in a vast northern woodland lake. Coming across a lost baby loon, they decide to go on a mini quest to rescue the baby bird and find its parents. Along the way, they realize how much hard work goes into raising young creatures.

videos.title: Shapes of the Armadillo
videos.overview: The Wild Kratts are looking at shapes in nature when they discover a sphere shaped “rock” that turns out to be a 3-banded armadillo! While they explore the many shapes of an armadillo body – from circles to triangles – Zach unexpectedly arrives and challenges them to a bowling match. Can the shapes of the armadillo help the Wild Kratts defeat Zach?

videos.title: Stealthazar The Leopard
videos.overview: Chris and Martin are delivering critically needed tellurium crystals back to the Tortuga when Zach tries to intercept their cargo. The brothers must borrow a few of the African leopard’s talents in an effort to protect their cargo and complete their mission.

videos.title: The Butternut Tree
videos.overview: Martin and Chris stumble upon a rare and endangered seedling of a butternut tree. While looking for its parent tree, they only discover dead ones.

videos.title: Shapes of the Armadillo
videos.overview: While looking at shapes in nature, the Wild Kratts discover a sphere shaped "rock" that turns out to be a 3-banded armadillo; Zach challenges everyone to a bowling match.

videos.title: Stealthazar the Leopard
videos.overview: Chris and Martin are delivering critically needed tellurium crystals back to the Tortuga when Zach tries to intercept their cargo. The brothers must borrow a few of the African leopard’s talents in an effort to protect their cargo and complete their mission.
